summary: Iteration-7 covers Phase-2 modular backend split + DashboardLayout decomposition + ALLOW_DEMO_LOGIN env flag + EN i18n keys. Backend regression + new Phase-2 tests all GREEN (84 passed, 2 skipped). Frontend layout decomposition is fully functional. CRITICAL i18n integration bug found: EN keys were added to /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.jsx but the four target page components (Billing.jsx, Verification.jsx, Projects.jsx, OpenBriefs.jsx) do NOT call useI18n()/t() — they still use hardcoded literals. As a result switching bm_lang=en does NOT switch the page titles/labels.

integration_issues.issue: Setting localStorage.bm_lang='en' does NOT change page titles/labels. Strings like 'Subscription & Billing', 'Company verification', 'My projects', 'Mark project completed' exist in /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.jsx under EN keys but the page files use HARDCODED Azerbaijani literals (e.g. Billing.jsx L86: title="Abunəlik və Ödəniş", Verification.jsx, Projects.jsx L69 title="Layihələrim", L37 toast="Layihə tamamlandı", L102/121 "Layihəni tamamla"). useI18n() / t('billing.title') is never imported or called. AZ default still works because the AZ literals are hardcoded. Only string matched in EN test was 'Open Brief Marketplace' on /provider/open-briefs — and that is because OpenBriefs.jsx (L43) has a HARDCODED ENGLISH literal as the default (it is NOT i18n either, and inconsistent with the AZ defaults of the other pages).

critical_code_review_comments: Phase-2 backend split is clean: routes/admin_resources.py + routes/media.py use a setup(deps) DI pattern; mounting order in server.py is correct (api_router -> business_routes inserted at front -> media include_router -> admin_resources include_router LAST so /admin/{resource} matches last). Verified empirically: /api/admin/plans / /companies / /users / /leads / /briefs / /stats all match their specific handlers, NOT the generic resource handler.

DashboardLayout decomposition into Sidebar/SidebarNav/SidebarHeader/SidebarUserBadge/SidebarFooter/DashboardTopbar preserves all data-testids (dashboard-sidebar, sidebar-collapse-toggle, sidebar-logout, topbar-menu-toggle, sidenav-*). Visual parity confirmed at desktop and mobile breakpoints.

ALLOW_DEMO_LOGIN env flag is correctly implemented in server.py L600 with safe default of 'false' — production deployments without the env var will automatically have the demo-login backdoor disabled. Good defense-in-depth.

I18N regression risk: adding EN keys to the dictionary without wiring t() calls in the consumer components is a no-op for the user. This is a frequent oversight — recommend a follow-up audit to find all hardcoded literals in pages/components that should be migrated to t().
File-size hygiene still pending: server.py is 3033 lines (down from 3187 — good progress from the Phase-2 split). business_routes.py still >700 lines.
Inconsistency: OpenBriefs.jsx uses an English literal as its default heading while sibling provider pages default to Azerbaijani — this should be normalized after i18n wiring.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE — i18n EN strings not rendering: the four target pages (provider/Billing.jsx L86, provider/Verification.jsx, provider/OpenBriefs.jsx L43, buyer/Projects.jsx L69/L37/L102/L121) use hardcoded string literals in their JSX instead of calling t(key) from useI18n(). Adding entries under the 'en' map in /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.jsx has no effect on these components because they never read from the translation dictionary. REPRODUCTION: page.evaluate(()=>localStorage.setItem('bm_lang','en')); page.goto('/provider/billing'); page.content() — observe 'Abunəlik və Ödəniş' (AZ literal) instead of expected 'Subscription & Billing'. MITIGATION: import { useI18n } from '@/lib/i18n'; const { t } = useI18n(); replace JSX literal with {t('billing.title')} and add namespace+key in BOTH az and en dictionaries (en already populated for many keys; AZ entries must be added to preserve current AZ rendering).
